subject: general
question:
What approximate value should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

444.033 ÷ 15.998 ÷ 37.02 × 11.992 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Given:**

444.033 ÷ 15.998 ÷ 37.02 × 11.992

 using the BODMAS rule,

= **444.033 ÷ 15.998** ÷ 37.02 × 11.992

= **27.755 ÷ 37.02** × 11.992

= 0.749 × 11.992

= 8.99

The approximate value of 8.99 is 9.

**Hence, “9” is the correct answer.**
